form.label: 1. Röntgengerät — DHCP / IP Drift
form.description: Detect when a critical, supposedly-static device silently gets reassigned by DHCP — before it takes an outage to notice.

html.blockquote: "Ein Röntgengerät ist letzte Woche ausgestiegen, weil die IP-Adresse aus unerklärlichen Gründen auf DHCP umgestellt wurde, was zu längerer Ursachenbehebung geführt hatte."
html.p: A radiology device that's supposed to hold a reserved/static address quietly picked up a new DHCP lease instead — the modality software couldn't reach PACS/RIS on the old address, and nobody had a record of the change, so troubleshooting started from zero instead of from "the IP changed at 14:32". With DHCP lease events, a switch-port/CDP trail and an asset inventory in Splunk, this becomes a single correlated alert instead of a multi-hour hunt.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: DHCP server logs — lease grant/renew/release events (Windows DHCP debug logs, ISC dhcpd, or Infoblox/BlueCat syslog) keyed by MAC address.
Asset / CMDB inventory — which MACs and IPs are supposed to be static/reserved, tagged by criticality (e.g. "modality", "life-safety").
Switch & access-layer logs — port config, CDP/LLDP and interface up/down (syslog or SNMP) to see which port/switch the device moved to or reset on.
Cisco ISE — endpoint identity and profiling (device type, VLAN assignment) to confirm the device's real network posture at the time of the event.
Optional: DNS logs to catch clients still resolving the old, now-stale IP.

panel.title: Example: unexpected DHCP lease change on a reserved medical device

search.query: | makeresults count=6 | streamstats count as i | eval Time=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval Asset=case(i=1,"MRI-Suite2-CTL",i=2,"US-Cardio-04",i=3,"XRAY-Radiology-03",i=4,"XRAY-Radiology-03",i=5,"Infusion-Pump-Gateway",i=6,"CT-Scanner-01") | eval "Assignment type"=case(i=1,"Static (reserved)",i=2,"Static (reserved)",i=3,"Static (reserved)",i=4,"DHCP (unexpected)",i=5,"Static (reserved)",i=6,"Static (reserved)") | eval "Previous IP"=case(i=1,"10.20.5.21",i=2,"10.20.5.33",i=3,"10.20.5.44",i=4,"10.20.5.44",i=5,"10.20.5.61",i=6,"10.20.5.72") | eval "New IP"=case(i=1,"10.20.5.21",i=2,"10.20.5.33",i=3,"10.20.5.44",i=4,"10.20.5.187",i=5,"10.20.5.61",i=6,"10.20.5.72") | eval Risk=case(i=4,"HIGH — reserved asset re-leased by DHCP",1=1,"normal renewal") | table Time Asset "Assignment type" "Previous IP" "New IP" Risk | sort Time

format.colorPalette: {"HIGH — reserved asset re-leased by DHCP":#d93f3c,"normal renewal":#53a051}

panel.title: Device reachability around the lease change — the outage that followed

search.query: | makeresults count=24 | streamstats count as i | eval Hour=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(24-i)."h"), "%H:00") | eval "Reachable (XRAY-Radiology-03)"=if(i>=15 AND i<=19, 0, 1) | table Hour "Reachable (XRAY-Radiology-03)"

panel.title: The SPL, once DHCP + CMDB are onboarded

html.pre: index=dhcp_logs sourcetype=dhcp:lease (action=ACK OR action=RENEW) | rename client_mac as mac | lookup asset_inventory mac OUTPUT ip as expected_ip, asset_name, criticality, assignment_type | where assignment_type="static" AND isnotnull(ip) AND ip!=expected_ip | eval alert_priority=if(criticality="life-safety" OR criticality="modality","critical","normal") | table _time asset_name mac expected_ip ip alert_priority
html.p: Wire this into an alert (any result in the last 5 minutes, alert_priority=critical) and page the network/biomed team before the modality drops off PACS — not after.
